ux_ui_principles: Cognitive Load Management: Limit initial steps to a maximum of 3-5 core screens to prevent user drop-off.
Progressive Disclosure: Introduce advanced features, deep configurations, and permissions contextually as the user explores the app.
Value Demonstration First: Deliver a tangible 'Aha! Moment' early in the flow before asking for heavy commitments like permissions or registration.
Frictionless Opt-outs and Backtracking: Allow users to easily skip non-essential steps (like profile customization) or change answers retroactively.

universal_structure_flow.title: Value Proposition & Introduction
ui_components: Clean visual illustration or animation previewing the app interface
Primary Call to Action (e.g., 'Get Started' or 'Take a Tour')
universal_structure_flow.user_intent: Understand immediately what problem the app solves for them.

universal_structure_flow.title: Tailored Configuration
ui_components: Single-select or multi-select cards for use-case identification
universal_structure_flow.user_intent: Customize the application experience to fit individual workflows or preferences.

universal_structure_flow.title: Consent & Authorization
ui_components: Contextual explanation cards explaining *why* a permission is needed before triggering system prompts
universal_structure_flow.user_intent: Grant necessary system rights securely with clear understanding of boundaries.

universal_structure_flow.title: The Aha! Moment (First Action)
ui_components: Guided interactive micro-task or sandbox environment
Immediate positive feedback loop (success animation, generated output, or completed action)
universal_structure_flow.user_intent: Experience the core benefit of the product firsthand.

universal_structure_flow.title: Completion & Transition
ui_components: Smooth transition animation into the main application UI/Dashboard
universal_structure_flow.user_intent: Exit onboarding seamlessly and land directly inside the ready-to-use application.
